stem.en: A copper wire is stretched to twice its original length, keeping the same volume (so its area halves). What happens to its resistance?
stem.et: Vasktraati venitatakse kaks korda pikemaks, hoides sama ruumala (seega selle pindala poolitub). Mis juhtub selle takistusega?

label.en: It quadruples — resistance grows with length and also with the drop in area
label.et: See neljakordistub — takistus kasvab pikkusega ja ka pindala vähenemisega

label.en: It doubles, tracking the length alone
It is unchanged, since the resistivity of copper has not changed
label.et: See ei muutu, sest vase eritakistus ei ole muutunud

label.en: It halves, since stretching thins the wire
label.et: See poolitub, sest venitamine muudab traadi õhemaks
